name: cs-filter-chat
description: Restyles the chat: your messages and Claude's replies, and nothing of the work between them. Off by default; the band's filter chat key or /filter-chat turns it on for a session.

youInk.title: cs: Filter chat: your lines' colour
youInk.description: The colour filter chat draws your messages in: remember is blue, planMode teal, success green, merged violet, error red, text your theme's text colour. Each follows your theme.
